scope: Thien Hau Temple at 710 Nguyễn Trãi in Cholon, including the forecourt and entrance, axial halls and open courtyards, ceramic roof ridges, lateral ranges and mapped rear range as represented in September 2019.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The government publication documents a 65 m by 27 m timber and tiled temple and the sequence of forecourt, entrance, front hall, light court, middle hall, incense hall and sanctuary.
Vietnam tourism identifies the three main halls and the historic ceramic figures and reliefs on the roof.

terrain.limitation: The raw field rises roughly 2.8 m inside the compound. It is an urban surface-height estimate. Keep the original grid intact and document any approximate visual registration.
